unit_of_analysis: reply position, bootstrap clustered by prompt

controls.note: permuted must be ~0.5 or the pipeline leaks; the prompt-mean oracle is the ceiling on any purely prompt-level signal, so clearing it is what shows the probe resolves tokens

memory_note: the donor is kept resident so the dense reference can be recomputed by a pointer swap; VRAM numbers must come from bench_gpu.py, not from this run

b9-entropy-whole.label: B9 entropy gate, whole remnant
b9-entropy-whole.purpose: confidence alternative: is the failure specific to max_prob?

b11-logitmargin-whole.label: B11 logit-margin gate, whole remnant
b11-logitmargin-whole.purpose: confidence alternative; note logit_margin is not confined to [0,1] so its threshold is in different units

b8-conf-random.label: B8 confidence + random groups
b8-conf-random.purpose: isolates the confidence contribution from the significance one

b10-csgqr.label: B10 CSGQR with a STATIC ranking
b10-csgqr.purpose: confidence-gated budget over a fixed global ranking; NOT the dynamic form -- see b16-csgqr-dyn

b12-probe-whole.label: B13 hidden-state need probe, whole-remnant gate
b12-probe-whole.purpose: the deployment gate: replaces the |V|/(3 d_ff) vocabulary projection with a d_model linear readout

b16-csgqr-dyn.label: B16 full CSGQR: probe gate + dynamic significance
b16-csgqr-dyn.purpose: the proposed method in the only form the evidence supports -- probe for how much, per-state utility for which groups

b16-csgqr-lens-dyn.label: B16b CSGQR with the exact lens gate
b16-csgqr-lens-dyn.purpose: same dynamic significance, but gated on the exact vocabulary lens: isolates the gate source from the group selector
